description: This file implements the RunC container management functionalities, including launching, stopping, and querying container states, as well as internal classes for handling container status and list entries. It interacts with the runc CLI tool and manages container lifecycle within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: RunCStatus
classes.description: Represents the status of a RunC container, including its PID and current state.

classes.name: RunCListEntry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the list of RunC containers, identified by an ID.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Manages a single RunC container, including starting, stopping, and retrieving its state.

classes.name: RunCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing multiple RunC containers, including creation, deletion, and lookup.

methods.name: callRunC
methods.description: Executes a runc command with specified options, captures output if requested, and returns a status code.

methods.name: RunCStatus::RunCStatus
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JSON container for container status.

methods.name: RunCListEntry::RunCListEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JSON container for a container list entry.

methods.name: RunCContainer::RunCContainer
methods.description: Constructor for a RunC container object.

methods.name: RunCContainer::~RunCContainer
methods.description: Destructor for a RunC container, ensuring cleanup.

methods.name: RunCContainer::Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the container if running.

methods.name: RunCContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: RunCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts a container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: RunCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: RunCContainerAdministrator::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the container administrator.

methods.name: RunCContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on ID and search paths.

methods.name: RunCContainerAdministrator::ContainerNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a container name is already in use.
